rationale:
dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=1234, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=3000, lr=0.001, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, rationale=iter-9 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE (learning rate) toward the iter-20 hard stop -- NOT hr-chasing. Change EXACTLY ONE knob: lr 0.005 -> 0.001 (5x LOWER Adam learning rate, applied to BOTH the amortized warm-start opt (solver line 185) and the per-scan _fit_one_scene opt (solver line 292)). Revert n_iter 800 -> 400 back to the iter-1 canonical 6-param config (iter-8 confirmed per-scan step count INERT: n_iter 400->800 -> 0.94624, flat hr 0) so this is a clean single-knob A/B isolating the lr axis. Everything else held at iter-1 canonical: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, img_n_bf=proj_n_bf=1, all sigmas at Wagner defaults, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=6, seed=1234 (iter-6-confirmed stable).

STATE: CONVERGED to the 6-param structural ceiling. 8 iters all flat at SSIM ~0.9462-0.9470 @1, hr 0 (PSNR ~35.6 dB, ~1 dB BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB): iter-1 0.946237, iter-2 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.945237, iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.005) 0.946177, iter-4 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.945745, iter-5 (warm_start OFF) 0.945955, iter-6 (seed 42->1234) 0.946157, iter-7 (pretrain_epochs 3->8) 0.946953, iter-8 (n_iter 400->800) 0.946240. This matches the documented dd-bf-supervised structural ceiling (capped 0.9502 with the SAME 6 BF params, every scalar flat).

FAILURE MODE (structural, not a tuning miss): the 6-param bilateral cannot beat an already-clean dense-view (2304-angle) FBP -- the half-view N2I information loss (each per-scan fit only ever sees a 1152-angle subset of the scan) exceeds what 6 trainable bilateral params can denoise, so no sigma/depth/warm_start/seed/warm-start-depth/per-scan-step setting clears hr=0. The remaining iters to iter-20 are CEILING DOCUMENTATION (probes that show WHY the ceiling holds), not optimization.

WHY THIS KNOB / NEW AXIS (untried): lr has stayed at the Wagner-2022 BF default 5e-3 in ALL 8 prior iters. It is a genuinely untried structural axis distinct from the per-scan STEP COUNT (iter-8) and warm-start DEPTH (iter-7): it changes the per-scan optimization REGIME (step size), not the budget. The campaign-state per-image-N2I insight is that the WORKING lever for the N2I family is per-scan lr DOWN (anchor near the warm-start init): U-Net mayo-n2i 0.9508->0.9541 at lr3e-4, breast-n2i 0.9553->0.9593 at lr1e-4, demo-n2i 0.4785->0.4880 at lr1e-4 -- a consistent cross-dataset lr-down lift. This probe tests whether that documented lr-down lever ALSO moves the 6-param BILATERAL N2I (which, unlike the U-Net, physically cannot overfit a single scan): if a 5x-lower lr lets the per-scan BF fit settle into a gentler edge-preserving optimum nearer the warm-start init, it could nudge SSIM; if it stays flat ~0.9462 hr 0, that CONFIRMS the bilateral ceiling is invariant to the per-scan lr regime -- the lr-down lever that helps the high-capacity U-Net does NOT apply to the 6-param BF, because the limit is BF CAPACITY vs the 2304-view FBP, not the optimization step size.

EXPECTATION (success condition for a ceiling-documentation probe): lr 5e-3->1e-3 is expected to land at essentially the SAME ~0.9462 @1, hr 0. A flat result bounds the ceiling along the lr axis and confirms the lr-down lever (which lifts the U-Net N2I) does not transfer to the 6-param bilateral. By construction this adds NO trainable capacity, so it cannot escape the ceiling -- it can only document its invariance to the per-scan lr regime. This is ceiling-documentation toward the iter-20 hard stop, not hr-chasing.

Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): short amortized warm-start pre-pass (3 ep x 200 train) then per-scan Adam fit (400 steps) on each val scan OWN half-angle measurements (GT-free), scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME L277 val scenes as every other Mayo method. NOT amortized train-then-forward. Wall <=15 min target: iter-1 ran 469s at lr=5e-3/n_iter=400/val_n=6; lr change does not affect runtime, n_iter back to 400 keeps it at ~470s, within the 1h sbatch wall and the <=15 min soft target.
